answer_1.quote: We approach embedding inversion attacks in the context of text generation, considering the generation models' efficacy in such attacks.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are reconstructed text sequences from sentence embeddings, aiming for exact or approximate text recovery in monolingual and cross-lingual settings.

answer_2.quote: To be comparable with , we assess model performance using two types of metrics. First, for text reconstruction, we employ the following word-match metrics: BLEU , measuring n-gram similarities between the true and reconstructed text; ROUGE , reporting the recall of overlapping words of reconstructed text; Token F1, which calculates the multi-class F1 scores between predicted tokens and true tokens, considering each word as a class; and Exact-match, representing the percentage of perfectly matching reconstructed texts to the true texts.
